subject: PO field requirements, pricing fence and invoice cadence for Synergetic Health pilot
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@synergetichealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: procurement@synergetichealth.com, Jordan Mitchell <jordan.m@synergetichealth.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO specs and invoicing cadence for pilot — question about discounts

Grace — thanks for the demo last week. Procurement asked me to share our PO template and confirm a few billing/terms items before we send an official PO: 

- Our AP requires: PO number, BillTo legal entity, Project/BU code (project_code), GL/account code, and a short description per PO line.
- Preferred invoice cadence: consolidated monthly invoices (one invoice per legal entity) with CSV line-item export for ERP import.
- Net terms: standard is Net 60 for our vendors. If vendor offers Net30 or early-pay discounts we may consider but need the discount rules spelled out in the contract.
- We sometimes require split invoices by BU for chargebacks across internal orgs — can you do separate invoices per BU if necessary?

Attached: Synergetic_PO_Template.xlsx (redacted). Also: what's the commercial on a 12-month committed pilot vs month-to-month? Any packaging or prepay discounts we should consider?

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
Director, Procurement
Synergetic Health
[attachment: Synergetic_PO_Template.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.inference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@synergetichealth.com>
Cc: procurement@synergetichealth.com, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Sep 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO specs and invoicing cadence for pilot — question about discounts

Hi Samantha — really appreciate the template and the clarity. Quick answers up front, more detail below: 

- We can accept Net 60 and issue consolidated monthly invoices per legal entity.
- We can include the Project/BU code as a dedicated invoice line/CSV column to make ERP mapping easier.
- Separate invoices per BU are possible but will require extra billing setup (one-off onboarding item).

Commercial options we can offer:
- 12-month committed pilot (monthly billing, Net60): 10% off list for the initial 12 months.
- Annual prepay: additional 5% off if you prepay the year upfront (applies instead of the monthly-commit discount).
- Volume tiers: if you cross usage thresholds we can add incremental credits/discounts.

Ive looped in Ben (pricing) and Vanessa (billing ops) to confirm the operational details and any caveats. If that sounds reasonable Ill prepare an updated SOW and quote.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Grace.O@redwood.inference.com
[signature: Redwood Inference]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.inference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@synergetichealth.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Sep 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: PO specs and invoicing cadence for pilot — pricing fence and billing notes

Folks — quick pricing/ops notes from finance: 

1) Discount fences (what we can commit to in the quote):
   - 12-month committed, monthly-billed, Net60: 10% off list (as Grace suggested).
   - Annual prepay (one invoice, up-front): additional 5% off (cannot be stacked with other promotional credits).
   - Early-pay (Net30) discount: we can offer 2.5% early-pay discount but this is mutually exclusive with the prepay incentive.

2) PO & invoice field requirements we need to settle before onboarding: 
   - Required PO fields: PO Number, BillTo legal entity, ShipTo (if different), Project/BU code (project_code), GL/Account code, Line-item description, Quantity, Unit price.
   - Please ensure the PO place the Redwood SKU on each line so our billing system can map usage to the proper ledger tags.

3) Invoice cadence / ERP mapping constraints: 
   - We can produce monthly consolidated invoices per legal entity (CSV + PDF).
   - Splitting invoices by BU (separate invoice per project_code) is possible but requires creating separate billing sub-entities in our system; that is a 5 business-day setup and a one-time $750 billing configuration fee.

4) Contract caveat: early-pay discounts and prepay discounts are not stackable and cannot be retroactively applied once invoices are issued.

If procurement can send the PO with the fields above well queue onboarding; Grace — once we have the PO well prepare the quote in HubSpot and open the DocuSign envelope.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
[attachment: pricing_summary.csv (text/csv)]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@synergetichealth.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Sep 2027 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: PO specs and invoicing cadence for pilot — operational details

Hi Samantha — thanks for the template. A couple of practical points from billing ops: 

- Project/BU code: we will populate a "project_code" column in our invoice CSV so your ERP team can auto-map to cost centers. Please confirm the exact field name your ERP expects (project_code vs cost_center).
- Acceptance-based hold: If Synergetic requires an acceptance code on the PO before AP will release payment, please include the acceptance clause in the PO and note the acceptance steps (we will mirror that in the SOW).
- Split invoices: If you absolutely need separate invoices per BU we can do that but we need explicit PO mapping per BU (i.e., separate PO lines per BU or multiple POs). Otherwise, consolidated monthly invoice + project_code column is the easiest path.

Attaching our recommended PO mapping template to show how project_code maps to invoice columns. Happy to have a short call with your ERP team to confirm mapping.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Billing Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
[attachment: PO_template_synergetic.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.inference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@synergetichealth.com>, procurement@synergetichealth.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Sep 2027 16:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO specs and invoicing cadence for pilot — confirmation and next steps

Samantha — thanks, all for the quick turn. Recap of what we agreed and next steps so procurement has something concrete to act on: 

Agreed commercial:
- 12-month committed pilot, billed monthly, Net60 = 10% off list for months 1–12.
- Annual prepay option = additional 5% off (one-time, exclusive; choose prepay instead of monthly discount).
- Early-pay (Net30) discount = 2.5% if you opt in on a per-invoice basis (cannot be combined with prepay).

Operational requirements from Synergetic to trigger onboarding:
- Send PO referencing DEAL-19872 with the following required fields: PO Number, BillTo legal entity, project_code (exact field name), GL code, Redwood SKU on each line, and PO line descriptions.
- If you require split invoices per BU, please issue separate POs per BU or indicate explicit line-level BU mapping. Otherwise we will deliver consolidated monthly invoices with a project_code column for ERP import.

Attachments we are sending: Redwood_SOW_v3.pdf (draft SOW reflecting the acceptance criteria and billing cadence). HubSpot quote will be created once PO is received: https://app.hubspot.com/quotes/4521/QUOTE-98765. DocuSign envelope will follow for signatures: https://www.docusign.com/envelope/ABC-1234.

Next steps: 
1) Procurement to confirm preferred field name for BU mapping (project_code or cost_center) and send the PO.
2) Once PO is received, Ben will finalize the quote and Vanessa will schedule the billing setup (if split invoices are required she will raise the one-time config).

Happy to hop on a 20-minute call if you want to walk through the PO template with your AP/ERP team.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[attachment: Redwood_SOW_v3.pdf (application/pdf)]
